Final review of the Host heavy-check slots section against code. Covered: the entry-point table (package.json, .githooks/pre-push, coordinator lanes and per-phase labels); sizing; the waiting message; FIFO tickets (typecheck-host-slots.mjs fifo); the bounded wait; the pid:birth marker; the hosted-CI exemption on GITHUB_ACTIONS only; and the admission order, coordinator then slot then typecheck/Biome. Also: a slot only once a lane or phase is admitted and executing, none for reuse/join, waits spending the lane deadline, a refusal published as infrastructure_error and retried because only passing receipts are reused, a deadline refusal reported as a timeout, and a fenced phase keeping its slot. Each claim is exercised by heavy-check-slots.test.ts, prepush-pure-merge.test.ts or verification-coordinator.test.ts.

A heavy-check refusal inside an executing lane rejects that execution, so the receipt is infrastructure_error with terminal.infrastructureCause carrying the FAIL message. That is the documented catch-all second channel ("the message of whatever rejected the execution, on every lane"). A refusal after the lane deadline is classified timed_out, also as documented. The status vocabulary and reuse rules are unchanged.
